name: ota-market-equilibrium-and-drift
what_it_holds: "Detection Engine" using Log-CUSUM to detect drift in RevPAR and Room-Nights weeks before quarterly targets are hit; appears to be a statistical-monitoring method demo, not a data feed. No confirmed committed hotel data; needs a contents check.
why_useful: If it ships any sample RevPAR/room-nights series alongside the detection method, it would be a small but real time series for gap #8; the CUSUM drift-detection method itself could also be reused as a nowcasting technique (gap #17).

name: GitHub topic: short-term-rental (survey page, not a single repo)
what_it_holds: Topic-tag listing surfacing STR-adjacent repos: Kamra-PMS (open-source hotel/STR property-management system), RentTools.io (Airbnb/Booking.com calendar sync tool), several Airbnb-scraper and MCP-agent projects (HasData/airbnb-mcp, everythingscraper/airbnb-scraper claiming occupancy/ADR/RevPAR extraction via Apify), and rochiecuevas/shared_accommodations (San Francisco peer-to-peer rental housing-market impact analysis). No committed multi-city European STR dataset found among the ~20 repos surveyed.
why_useful: Confirms the current landscape of STR tooling repos is dominated by generic commercial scrapers/PMS software rather than city-specific European STR datasets; the everythingscraper/airbnb-scraper (claims ADR/RevPAR/occupancy extraction) is the only entry that, if it worked and were run against non-prohibited sources, would speak to gap #2 (realised ADR/occupancy) -- but it scrapes airbnb.com directly, which is out of scope for us to run.
last_activity: varies; topic page reflects current top repos as of Sep 2026
themes: Amsterdam, Berlin, Vienna, Copenhagen, Prague, Lisbon, Athens, Florence, Venice, Dublin STR datasets and city-report data appendices

name: airbnb_webscraping (hucodelab)
what_it_holds: A small scraper described as performing 'web scraping of airbnb in Sao Paulo - BR'. 1 star, last updated 2022-06-25. Method/tooling repo, not a stored dataset; not run per CLAUDE.md rule 6 (scraping airbnb.com directly is a terms-of-service decision for a human).
why_useful: Illustrates that Sao Paulo listing-level scraping code exists publicly, but it scrapes airbnb.com directly, which is outside our sanctioned-source list; catalogued as a method only, left unrun.

name: zachporreca/safegraph_DiD_piecewise_likelihood_MLE
what_it_holds: Julia script (1 star, no license stated) implementing a difference-in-differences / piecewise-likelihood MLE estimator specifically built to handle the censoring and truncation quirks of publicly released SafeGraph Patterns data.
why_useful: If the team ever gets hold of any POI-visit panel (SafeGraph, Advan, or a municipal foot-traffic dataset) with similar top/bottom-coding, this is a directly reusable estimator rather than a from-scratch build.

name: Texas-Nightlights-Economic-Activity
what_it_holds: Code pipeline (Google Earth Engine + deep learning) pulling VIIRS nighttime-lights imagery as a proxy for sub-state local economic activity in Texas.
why_useful: A smaller, state-level template for the same nighttime-lights-as-tourism-proxy idea, worth checking as an alternative extraction method to the global one above, e.g. around Austin/Hill Country STR clusters already in our Inside Airbnb panel.
